Subject: Re: Users can't receive mails (SOLVED)

Hi mouss,


Problem solves as follow;


# nano /etc/procmailrc

copying following 3 lines on it;
DROPPRIVS=YES 
ORGMAIL=$HOME/Maildir/ 
DEFAULT=$ORGMAIL
  * end *


Keeping the line;
mailbox_command = procmail -a "$EXTENSION"

on /etc/postfix/main.cf


All incoming mails are now delivered to the respective $HOME/Maildir


B.R.
Stephen L
